findings.title: Same NPE remains in the other getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: The fix null-checks `modelSupplier.get()` only in `getSubGroupsCount()`. The three `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads (lines 256, 262, 268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` without a null check. If the group is deleted concurrently, `LazyModel` returns null from `getGroupById` and these methods throw the same NPE this PR is meant to fix. Listing a group's subgroups while the group is being removed hits that path. The null handling should be applied consistently, for example by returning `Stream.empty()` when the model is gone.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount now returns null for a vanished group
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` now returns `null` when the delegate group no longer exists, instead of throwing. Callers may unbox the `Long` or compare it numerically, and `GroupModel` does not document a null contract. Returning null silently hides the deletion and can move the NPE to the caller. Returning 0L, or an explicit documented outcome, would be safer.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the concurrency test can miss failures and leak a thread
findings.body: The background reader is started with `new Thread(...).start()` and never joined. After `deletedAll.set(true)` the test asserts immediately on `caughtExceptions`. An exception thrown by the reader's last in-flight iteration can be added after the assertion and go unnoticed. The thread may also keep making requests while the test tears down. The thread should be joined before asserting, ideally via an executor or a `Future`. The race is also timing-dependent and only loosely tied to the NPE being fixed.

findings.title: Test does not exercise the changed code path
findings.body: The reader calls `groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true)`, a brief listing. The fix changed `getSubGroupsCount()` in `GroupAdapter`. That method is only reached when the subgroup count is requested, via `populateSubGroupCount` with `subGroupsCount=true`. If the endpoint call does not request counts, the test does not cover the fix and may pass without it. The query should request subgroup counts, or the test should check that it fails without the fix.
